newsitem.title: CANADA: NORTEL SEES GERMAN DEAL WORTH C$560 MLN.
newsitem.headline: NORTEL SEES GERMAN DEAL WORTH C$560 MLN.

text.p: Northern Telecom Ltd's joint venture Nortel Dasa won a supply deal worth up to C$560 million to help build a mobile phone network in Germany, Chief Operating Officer John Roth said on Wednesday.
Viag Interkom AG said on Wednesday that it placed orders worth about one billion German marks for the network. The company is owned by German utility Viag AG, British Telecom and Norway's Telenor.

Roth said the deal to provide switching systems and other equipment was worth between 300-400 million German marks (about C$221-C$295 million). Nortel Dasa is a joint venture between Nortel and Daimler Benz Aerospace.
This lets Nortel prove itself while the European telecom market begins deregulation, Roth said.
